card.name: Inside salt names and sodium terms
card.fires_on: Partway through names of salts, such as the H in amiloride HCl or the start of benzoate and taurocholate after sodium. Also on the word sodium or potassium when it introduces a salt form.

modes.label: Hydrochloride abbreviation
modes.description: The H of HCl right after a drug name such as amiloride.
modes.example: DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION Amiloride<< H>>Cl should be administered with food.

modes.label: After sodium
modes.description: The start of a salt name that follows the word sodium, such as benzoate or taurocholate.
modes.example: amphetamine, dextroamphetamine, or caffeine with sodium<< ben>>zoate is recommended.

modes.label: Salt cation word
modes.description: The word sodium or potassium naming the salt form of a drug.
modes.example: and 42.9 mg of clavulanic acid as the<< potassium>> salt.

card.writes: It pushes the model away from predicting sodium, potassium and calcium words and toward word endings like -ate.
card.plain: It fires inside salt names, such as sodium benzoate or amiloride HCl, where the next piece finishes the salt name.
